USD.note: Fed seen holding on 28 Oct (94 of 100 economists) with a December hike near-unanimous; pricing already matches that path. Risk-off regime adds mild haven support.

EUR.note: ECB expected to hold on 29 Oct with softer guidance than the tightening still priced; Moody's kept France at Aa3 negative, but budget votes on 3 and 17 Nov keep risk live.

GBP.note: September CPI 3.5% and services 3.7% beat, unemployment fell to 4.7%; a 5 Nov BoE hike is 93-96% priced. The 28 Oct Budget is the fiscal test.

JPY.note: Core CPI 2.1% (in line) and core-core 2.4% (beat); BoJ seen holding on 30 Oct with December in view. Intervention backstop and risk-off support the yen.

CHF.note: SNB at 0% with no move priced before 10 Dec gives the lowest carry of the eight; haven demand in a risk-off regime offsets part of it.

CAD.note: Macklem's hawkish turn lifted 28 Oct hike odds to about 80% despite core CPI near 1.85%; oil supports, live US tariffs weigh.

AUD.note: Highest carry at 4.60%; Hauser says the inflation outlook is materially worse, lifting November hike odds to about 56%. Iron ore down 6.5% in a month weighs.

NZD.note: Q3 CPI mixed (3.7% headline miss, firmer trimmed mean); a 28 Oct hike is largely priced. GDT auctions rose 1.2% and 2.5%; risk-off weighs.

XAU.note: Gold factor G = +1: US breakevens fell 41bp in four weeks against haven demand and central-bank buying; real yields flat. XAU = G + USD = +3.
